provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (part A): First download 2026-09-25 12:11:43Z-12:12:26Z (plain, identity); re-downloaded 12:49:33Z (plain) and 12:49:33Z (with a cache-busting &cb= query), each with the same byte count and SHA-256. The part A check downloaded it again at 12:58Z-12:59Z and 13:40Z-13:42Z on 25 September 2026 (the Diet API responses also with a cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 14:16:00Z and 14:52:27Z, 36 minutes apart, and at 14:56:53Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 本会議 第3号 (1991-11-11), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/112205254X00319911111. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office.

visual_review.method: Machine-readable minute text read in full for the cited speeches and the surrounding questions; the printed page images were not viewed.

rows.text: Speaking for the LDP (自由民主党を代表して) in the House of Representatives on 11 November 1991, 森喜朗, whom the reply in the same sitting addresses as 森政調会長 (the LDP's policy research council chairman), said 宮澤総理 had been chosen (選任) as the 15th president in the LDP presidential election held on the expiry of the term, with broad support from party members.

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
